001package org.clafer.choco.constraint.propagator;
002
003import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.Propagator;
004import org.chocosolver.solver.constraints.PropagatorPriority;
005import org.chocosolver.solver.exception.ContradictionException;
006import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.BoolVar;
007import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.SetVar;
008import org.chocosolver.solver.variables.Variable;
009import org.chocosolver.util.ESat;
010import org.chocosolver.util.objects.setDataStructures.ISetIterator;
011
012/**
013 * TODO: implement as two reifysetequal && result subset (consequent union alternative)
014 *  
015 * @author jimmy
016 */
017public class PropSetTernary extends Propagator<Variable> {
018
019    private final BoolVar antecedent;
020    private final SetVar result, consequent, alternative;
021
022    public PropSetTernary(BoolVar antecedent, SetVar result, SetVar consequent, SetVar alternative) {
023        super(new Variable[]{antecedent, result, consequent, alternative}, PropagatorPriority.BINARY, false);
024        this.antecedent = antecedent;
025        this.result = result;
026        this.consequent = consequent;
027        this.alternative = alternative;
028    }
029
030    @Override
031    public void propagate(int evtmask) throws ContradictionException {
032        if (!antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
033            if (!PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(result, consequent)
034                    || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(consequent, result)) {
035                antecedent.instantiateTo(0, this);
036            } else if (!PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(result, alternative)
037                    || !PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(alternative, result)) {
038                antecedent.instantiateTo(1, this);
039            } else {
040                ISetIterator iter = result.getUB().iterator();
041                while (iter.hasNext()) {
042                    int i = iter.nextInt();
043                    if (!consequent.getUB().contains(i) && !alternative.getUB().contains(i)) {
044                        result.remove(i, this);
045                    } else if (consequent.getLB().contains(i) && alternative.getLB().contains(i)) {
046                        result.force(i, this);
047                    }
048                }
049            }
050        }
051        if (antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
052            if (antecedent.getValue() == 1) {
053                PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(result, consequent, this);
054                PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(consequent, result, this);
055                PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(result, consequent, this);
056                PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(consequent, result, this);
057            } else {
058                PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(result, alternative, this);
059                PropUtil.envSubsetEnv(alternative, result, this);
060                PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(result, alternative, this);
061                PropUtil.kerSubsetKer(alternative, result, this);
062            }
063        }
064    }
065
066    @Override
067    public ESat isEntailed() {
068        boolean possibleTrue
069                = PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(result, consequent)
070                && PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(consequent, result);
071        boolean possibleFalse
072                = PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(result, alternative)
073                && PropUtil.isKerSubsetEnv(alternative, result);
074        if (!possibleTrue && !possibleFalse) {
075            return ESat.FALSE;
076        }
077        if (antecedent.isInstantiated()) {
078            if (antecedent.getValue() == 1) {
079                if (!possibleTrue) {
080                    return ESat.FALSE;
081                }
082                return result.isInstantiated() && consequent.isInstantiated()
083                        ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
084            } else {
085                if (!possibleFalse) {
086                    return ESat.FALSE;
087                }
088                return result.isInstantiated() && alternative.isInstantiated()
089                        ? ESat.TRUE : ESat.UNDEFINED;
090            }
091        }
092        if (possibleTrue && possibleFalse
093                && result.isInstantiated()
094                && consequent.isInstantiated()
095                && alternative.isInstantiated()) {
096            return ESat.TRUE;
097        }
098        return ESat.UNDEFINED;
099    }
100
101    @Override
102    public String toString() {
103        return result + " = " + antecedent + " ? " + consequent + " : " + alternative;
104    }
105}
